_meta.purpose: Static pricing reference for the token-cost surfaces (Phase 48). Published per-MTok prices; refreshed via normal skeleton updates, not fetched at runtime.
_meta.cache_note: Cache multipliers apply to the model's input price: reads bill at cache_read_multiplier x input; writes at cache_write_multiplier_5m (5-minute TTL) or cache_write_multiplier_1h (1-hour TTL) x input. Since Phase 136 a model row MAY carry cache_read_per_mtok (an absolute USD/MTok cache-read price), which overrides the multiplier for that model - the platform now publishes cache-read prices per model rather than as one ratio. Cache tokens dominate real agentic sessions - never drop them from a cost estimate.
_meta.tokenizer_note: Newer model families use a new tokenizer that produces roughly 30% more tokens for equivalent text (e.g. claude-sonnet-5 vs claude-sonnet-4-6). Cross-model cost comparisons must compare MEASURED token counts, never text length.
_meta.intro_note: claude-sonnet-5 has introductory pricing (intro_* fields) through intro_ends; the base fields are the standing price.
_meta.sources_2026_11_02: Claude Code changelog: 2.1.257 (Fable 5.1: $10/$50, cache reads $0.25), 2.1.280 (Opus 5.5: $4/$20, cache reads $0.20), 2.1.284 (Sonnet 5.5: $2/$10, cache reads $0.20) and 2.1.296 (Sonnet 5.5 cache reads cut to $0.10), 2.1.293 (Haiku 5.5: $0.10/$0.50; $0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K - the long-prompt tier is NOT modelled here). Cache WRITE multipliers for the 5.5 family were not published in the entries read; the global 1.25 / 2.0 multipliers stand as the assumption. Older rows are kept as history for old rollups.
